fda-device-z-1490-2026.title: Esaote Endocavity ultrasonic probe recall (ESAOTE S.P.A.)
fda-device-z-1490-2026.product: Esaote Endocavity ultrasonic probe, Model E 3-12, REF 120000038
fda-device-z-1490-2026.reason: A potential weakness has been identified in the probe body, so that, in a specific production batch, liquid may leak from the terminal part of the casing near the cable.
fda-device-z-1490-2026.distribution: US: Nationwide distribution in the states of NC and TX.
